findings.summary: crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The bare anchors `fails without` and `without it` match a criterion that only describes error behavior, which plans easy jobs for no reason.
findings.evidence: The plan requires a `fail*` word plus an anchor, but the bare anchor `fails without` matches itself, so any Behavior criterion that says something 'fails without X' passes. In this repository such criteria usually describe error behavior: 'athena plan fails without acceptance bullets', 'the command fails without a config file'. `without it` is just as loose. `on the base`, if matched as a substring and not on whole words, also matches 'on the base64 …'. Rejected alternative 2b says broad matching 'would plan easy jobs for no reason', and these anchors bring that back. An over-match costs only a planning round, so this is not major. Fix: Remove the bare `fails without` and `without it` anchors. Keep `without the (fix|change|patch|mechanism)`, `before the fix` and `on the base`, and match them on whole words of the normalized text. Add 'athena plan fails without acceptance bullets' to the unit test's negative cases.
findings.location: Decision 2 / Step 2: anchor list `fails without`, `without it`, `on the base`

findings.summary: checks.rs is outside the listed deliverables but is needed for criterion 3; the change description should say why it is touched.
findings.evidence: checks.rs is not a listed deliverable. It is still needed: checks.rs:130-146 gates `Guard`/`install` behind `#[cfg(test)]`, and checks.rs:94-97 `demo_runs_here` returns false in a test-support build unless a seam is installed. Without the change, criterion 3 (fails-without-1 in the CLI verifier prompt) cannot be shown. The widening is small and test-only (Cargo.toml:31 enables `test-support` in athena-cli's dev-dependencies). Fix: Keep the change. In the change description, say that checks.rs is touched only to widen the cfg so criterion 3 can be shown, so the verifier does not count it as scope creep.

findings.summary: The unannotated `|_|` closure for the demo runner may fail to coerce to the Mapper type.
findings.evidence: `install` takes `Mapper = Rc<dyn Fn(&[String]) -> Vec<String>>` (checks.rs:124). A closure written `|_|` with no annotation and then coerced can fail the higher-ranked signature check. The core test annotates it as `move |_argv: &[String]|` (tests.rs:3098). Fix: Write the closure as `|_argv: &[String]| …`, as tests.rs:3098 does.

summary: I checked the plan against the code by reading it. The fix goes where the fault starts: the gate at run/mod.rs:808 is `p.plans(reading.hard_reason.is_some())` and nothing else. ORing in a reading-derived helper leaves `JobPlanConfig::plans` and its tests (config.rs 856-857, 1175-1181) untouched. The other readers of `hard_reason` (reading.rs:782 and 833, producer model and effort) are deliberately left unchanged. The preflight at reading.rs:100 already reserves planning rounds whenever `[job_plan]` exists, so the dependents list is complete. The demonstrations can run. The CLI tests in job_plan.rs call `athena.ask`/`go` in-process on the test thread (job_plan.rs:1268), so the thread-local demo seam will be seen there. The Scenario fixture copies criterion texts from the reading into `criteria_check` (common/mod.rs:585-594), so replacing the text is safe. The core tests show 'fails-without-1: not a check' whether or not the revert run fails (tests.rs 3145, 3179). Each behavior demonstration fails under the old gate, because the roles would be [Reader, Producer, Verifier] and there would be no record. On soundness: the text heuristic is what the accepted reading asks for (the structured field is out of scope). It is limited to Behavior criteria and needs a fail-word plus an anchor. Only the bare `fails without` and `without it` anchors are loose enough to plan easy error-behavior jobs (minor). The checks.rs edit outside the deliverables is needed for criterion 3. No blocker or major findings.
